ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
to draw a conclusion or move on

examples.trans: Yes, three hundred thousand. I'm talking about his twenty years of career.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Au club de jazz où il jouait.
examples.trans: At the jazz club where he was playing.

examples.text: C'était à New York, au club de jazz où il jouait.
examples.trans: It was in New York, at the jazz club where he was playing.

meanings.note: French relational/descriptive adjective derived from Latin adjectival roots. Prefix 'com-' (from Latin 'cum') means 'with, together'.

examples.text: Allons plutôt dans un club comique.
examples.trans: Let us go instead to a comedy club.

examples.text: J'ai complètement raté ma carrière comique!
examples.trans: I have completely missed out on my comedic career!

examples.text: Tu as complètement perdu la tête!
Gabriel, tu as complètement perdu la tête!
examples.trans: Gabriel, you've completely lost your mind!

meanings.note: Manner adverb formed by adding '-ment' (from Latin 'mente', 'with a ... mind') to the feminine adjective stem. Prefix 'com-' (from Latin 'cum') means 'with, together'.

examples.text: Parce qu'en fait, je suis comédienne.

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: je n'ai pas de temps; also before a plural adjective: de mauvaises nouvelles

examples.text: Clémentine? Celle de la semaine dernière?

meanings.note: after the noun: la semaine dernière = last week
before the noun: le dernier jour

examples.text: Moi, je n'ai pas envie de rire.
Elle m'a donné envie de tout arrêter.

meanings.note: avoir envie de + infinitive = to feel like doing
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

meanings.note: for masculine nouns, and in impersonal phrases: il y a
